meta.name: Landscapers 2021
meta.description: A seemingly ordinary British couple become the focus of an extraordinary investigation when two dead bodies are discovered in the back garden of a house in Nottingham.

videos.title: Episode One
videos.overview: The building blocks of Christopher and Susan Edwards’ carefully reconstructed life begin to collapse after a single phone call.

videos.title: Episode Two
videos.overview: As the investigation into the Mansfield double murder continues, Susan and Chris's past is revealed and secrets emerge.

videos.title: Episode Three
videos.overview: Christopher opens up about his past as the couple's relationship with Susan's parents comes under the spotlight. Lancing and Wilkie have a breakthrough.

videos.title: Episode Four
videos.overview: Truth and fantasy clash as Susan and Christopher Edwards face trial. Meeting for the first time since their arrest, old doubts and new regrets test their love.
